title: D2P Seam Interface
description: A seam interface: an ordered, continuous chain of edge intervals on one piece and one cut instance that can be sewn to another interface (design decisions ADR-007, ADR-007.1). Continuity is D2P-SEM-020, single piece / cut instance is D2P-SEM-022.

seamInterface.title: Seam interface
seamInterface.description: A sewable chain of edge intervals.

id.description: Stable element ID of the seam interface.

segments.description: Edge intervals in sewing direction. Consecutive intervals MUST be continuous (D2P-SEM-020).

cutInstanceKey.description: Cut instance the interface belongs to. Required when the piece has more than one cut instance (D2P-SEM-022, semantic, not schema-enforced); absent means the piece's implicit instance.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension blocks (§1.7 of the schema catalog).

edgeInterval.title: Edge interval
edgeInterval.description: A sub-interval of one edge. Parameters are normalized arc length along the edge direction. 'from' MUST be less than 'to' (D2P-SEM-021). A forward interval runs from 'from' to 'to', a reverse interval from 'to' to 'from'.

from.description: Lower interval bound in [0, 1] (normalized arc length along the edge direction).

to.description: Upper interval bound in [0, 1] (normalized arc length along the edge direction).

direction.description: Traversal direction of the interval relative to the edge direction.
